description: This file defines a utility enum 'BonjourServiceResolverSupport' that provides static methods for starting network service resolution and normalizing host strings in the context of Bonjour service discovery.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Schedules the given NetService to resolve within a specified mode and timeout.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Removes whitespace and newlines from the host string and trims trailing periods if present.
